notes: Modified cash basis city, fiscal year ended 9/30/2025. Governmental receipts/disbursements from the Total column of the Governmental Funds Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances (p6); beginning cash = beginning fund balance 1,114,211 (p7), ending 3,244,140 (p4/p7); governmental transfers in 80,000 (Street) and out 80,000 (General) offset, matching. Taxes 2,350,081 split using statement of activities (p2-3) and General Fund schedule (p14/p16): property 896,856 (computed), motor vehicle 95,194, sales 1,217,724, hotel occupation 74,335, NPPD 5% 65,972. Miscellaneous revenue 1,006,141 split into NPPD lease 622,313, LB 840 loan repayments 299,387, franchise fees 27,061 (gas 12,075 + cable TV 14,986, p16; matches Franchise fees on p3) Keno 1,188 (p24), lot sales/rural fire/other park 17,138 (p16-17, charges for services) and remainder 39,054 (computed, review). Street Fund Motor vehicle fees 36,527 (p25) split out of Intergovernmental revenues as motor vehicle tax. Public Building (Community Center only) mapped to culture/recreation. Business-type: Combined Utilities Fund (Water, Sewer, Solid Waste) from proprietary statement of revenues, expenditures and changes in net position (p10-11), measure net position; no printed total receipts, so receipts total computed (operating revenues 3,263,193 + interest 17,609 + city sales tax 213,525); disbursements 2,863,467 = operating expenditures 2,810,357 + interest and fees 53,110 (printed on p2). Balance sheet = Statement of Net Position, Total column (p1), no deferred items (kept: the government-wide statement holds capital assets and debt). Detail: General Fund detailed schedule (p16-22) recorded instead of the all-funds combined budget schedule (p14-15, which mixes all funds), plus Street, Community Improvement, CDBG (p28), Keno, TIF, LB 840 and Debt Service (p33) fund schedules (CDBG and Debt Service schedules added by the v8 re-trim; they replace the one-line all-funds schedule entries used before). The Other Governmental Funds combining statement (p24, TIF/CDBG/Keno) is not recorded in detail since each of those funds has its own schedule; business-type detail is the Combined Utilities statement of revenues, expenditures and changes in net position by department, modified cash (p36-37: Water, Sewer, Solid Waste; nonoperating interest and city sales tax lines marked outside_printed_total), which replaced the three budgetary-basis utility expenditure lines taken from the all-funds schedule before the v8 re-trim. Detail lines with a blank 2025 actual (E-911, Fire Miscellaneous and Lights and wiring, Police vehicle payments, Library Miscellaneous, Community Center Employee insurance and Miscellaneous, Park improvement, Street Federal grant, Street improvements, Snow and tree removal, CI Other) were omitted; each schedule's printed totals still tie. Accrual-basis statements (p40-45) show operating income 441,401 versus 452,836 on the modified cash basis statements (p10, p36); not used. Proprietary cash flow statements (p12-13, p38-39, p44-45) not recorded in proprietary field (cash basis). The v8 re-trim also added p32 (Debt Service Fund balance sheet), p34-35 (Combined Utilities assets/liabilities/net position by department, modified cash; total 12,870,948 agrees with p8-9) and p40-43 (accrual-basis utility statements); these confirm existing figures and add nothing else. Fix 2026-10-27: Homestead exemption 47,747, Property tax credit 63,874 and Prorate motor vehicle 1,818 split out of Intergovernmental revenues (state aid now 972,376); NPPD lines category Public Power District Sales Tax; General Fund 'Capital expenditures' (administration 2,295, cemetery 26,943) category capital outlay. Attempt 2 (2026-10-28 targeted re-check): proprietary statement 'Miscellaneous' expense 34,363 (p10) is a cost type, so category other with function utilities (was utilities), matching the per-department detail lines; the two proprietary 'Miscellaneous' lines now carry the printed label without an added qualifier; Street Fund 'Capital outlay - other' 558,115 labelled Capital Outlay: Streets/Highways (printed_label kept).
